title: 2587. Rearrange Array to Maximize Prefix Score

examples.explanation: We can rearrange the array into nums = [2,3,1,-1,-3,0,-3]. prefix = [2,5,6,5,2,2,-1], so the score is 6. It can be shown that 6 is the maximum score we can obtain.
Any rearrangement of the array will result in a score of 0.
